jobs.title: Software Automation & Platform Engineer — Federal Health IT
jobs.description:
**Software Automation & Platform Engineer — Federal Health IT**

**Location:** Remote — United States

**Engineer Smarter Workflows. Deliver More Reliable Federal Health IT Services.**

Rackner is seeking a Software Automation & Platform Engineer to design, build, and advance automation capabilities that strengthen complex enterprise technology operations.

In this hands-on role, you'll transform manual processes into efficient, reliable workflows that improve service delivery, reduce operational friction, and enable teams to work more effectively. You'll engineer solutions across ServiceNow, enterprise integrations, and modern software delivery platforms, combining technical expertise with practical problem-solving.

Working alongside engineering, architecture, security, and operations teams, you'll modernize established systems, resolve integration challenges, and deliver measurable improvements while maintaining service continuity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate automation opportunities using service data, operational trends, and stakeholder input; maintain a prioritized automation backlog that supports informed decisions and measurable service improvements.
* Build, test, and enhance ServiceNow workflows using Flow Designer and Integration Hub, including request catalogs, role templates, and self-service forms that streamline service delivery.
* Develop and maintain REST API integrations that connect ServiceNow with approved enterprise systems, enabling reliable data exchange and coordinated workflows.
* Engineer and optimize GitLab CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code solutions, incorporating automated testing, quality checks, and security practices to strengthen software delivery.
* Integrate approved AI-assistant capabilities with ServiceNow case creation and authorized knowledge resources while operating within applicable security and operational requirements.
* Validate automation and integration changes, diagnose technical issues, and implement improvements that increase reliability, maintainability, and operational performance.
* Execute controlled releases and limited pilots in coordination with authorized stakeholders, measure results against approved requirements, and support troubleshooting or rollback when necessary.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional software engineering or platform engineering experience.
* Hands-on experience developing automation with ServiceNow Flow Designer and Integration Hub.
* Experience with GitLab CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
* Developing or implementing REST API integrations.
* Eligibility for a Tier 3 federal background investigation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform.
* Developing or integrating AI-assisted workflows, including large language model (LLM) or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, in security-controlled environments.
* Supporting software automation, platform engineering, or enterprise integrations within federal technology or similarly regulated environments.

**Why Rackner?**

At Rackner, you'll contribute to engineering improvements that help federal healthcare teams deliver dependable technology services.

This position brings together software development, platform automation, and enterprise integration, giving you the opportunity to solve meaningful operational challenges and see the impact of your work.

You'll collaborate with experienced technical professionals, strengthen systems that support essential services, and help translate engineering solutions into lasting operational value.

**Benefits & Perks**

Rackner offers a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.
* Professional development and company-supported certification opportunities.
* Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
* Fitness and wellness reimbursement programs.
* Weekly pay and company team events.
* Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

**Work Arrangement**

This position is remote within the United States.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III — TS/SCI w/poly clearance
jobs.description:
CyberTrend’s leadership has 40 years of experience in the industry, and the company continues to serve as a technology leader on many defense projects and programs. Formed in 2010, CyberTrend has long-standing partnerships and clients, including partners like AWS and IBM, government agencies, the intelligence community, and defense contractors. We provide talented and exceptionally qualified IT, architectural, system, and software engineering personnel.  
  
  
**Requires TS/SCI with Poly Clearance**  
  
  
The Software Engineer develops, maintains, and enhances complex and diverse software systems (e.g., processing-intensive analytics, novel algorithm development, manipulation of extremely large data sets, real-time systems, and business management information systems) based upon documented requirements. Works individually or as part of a team. Reviews and tests software components for adherence to the design requirements and documents test results. Resolves software problem reports. Utilizes software development and software design methodologies appropriate to the development environment. Provides specific input to the software components of system design to include hardware/software trade-offs, software reuse, use of Commercial Off-the-shelf (COTS)/Government Off-the-shelf (GOTS) in place of new development, and requirements analysis and synthesis from system level to individual software components.

  

Twenty (20) years experience as a SWE in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required. Four (4) years of additional SWE experience on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree.  
  
  
**Discretionary Requirements**  
Cloud Experience: Shall have five (5) years demonstrated work experience with distributed scalable Big Data Store (NoSQL) such as HBase, CloudBase/Accumulo, Bigtable, etc.; Shall have demonstrated work experience with the Map Reduce programming model and technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Pig, etc.; Shall have demonstrated work experience with the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS); Shall have demonstrated work experience with Serialization such as JSON and/or BSON  
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Analyze user requirements to derive software design and performance requirements
* Design and code new software or modify existing software to add new features
* Debug existing software and correct defects
* Integrate existing software into new or modified systems or operating environments
* Develop simple data queries for existing or proposed databases or data repositories
* Provide recommendations for improving documentation and software development process standards
* Develop or implement algorithms to meet or exceed system performance and functional standards
* Assist with developing and executing test procedures for software components
* Write or review software and system documentation
* Develop software solutions by analyzing system performance standards, confer with users or system engineers; analyze systems flow, data usage and work processes; and investigate problem areas
* Serve as team lead at the level appropriate to the software development process being used on any particular project
* Modify existing software to correct errors, to adapt to new hardware, or to improve its performance
* Design, develop and modify software systems, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcome and consequences of design
* Design or implement complex database or data repository interfaces/queries
* Oversee one or more software development teams and ensure the work is completed in accordance with the constraints of the software development process being used on any particular project
* Design or implement complex algorithms requiring adherence to strict timing, system resource, or interface constraints;
* Perform quality control on team products
* Confer with system engineers and hardware engineers to derive software requirements and to obtain information on project limitations and capabilities, performance requirements and interfaces
* Coordinate software system installation and monitor equipment functioning to ensure operational specifications are met
* Implement recommendations for improving documentation and software development process standards
* Serve as the technical lead of multiple software development teams
* Select the software development process in coordination with the customer and system engineering
* Recommend new technologies and processes for complex software projects
* Ensure quality control of all developed and modified software
* Delegate programming and testing responsibilities to one or more teams and monitor their performance

**Required skills**

* Linux command line
* Building microservices in Java and Spring
* Docker and containerd
* Kubernetes
* Grafana and Prometheus monitoring
* Git

**Desired skills**

* Continuous integration and delivery tools (GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
* OpenSearch or Elasticsearch
* NiFi for managing and ingesting data flows
* Amazon HCI platform
* Strong debugging, documentation and communication skills
* Agile, multi-disciplinary team experience

**Other details**

* Telework up to 16 hours a week, at leadership’s discretion

**Benefits:**

* Generous and competitive paid time off, scaled based on time in service, plus eleven paid annual holidays.
* CyberTrend pays 100% of the cost for the following benefits for its full-time employees: including medical (base plan), dental, vision, disability, life, EAP, and more.
* CyberTrend contributes 10% of your monthly gross salary to a SEP-IRA account. This retirement plan is non-contributory for the employee, has no vesting period, and is 100% owned and managed by the employee.
* Educational assistance up to $5,250 annually for work-related activities upon prior approval
* Trai

jobs.title: Hardware/System/Software Engineers
jobs.description:
Summary:

We are looking for talented engineers to joint the team. Engineers have vital roles in driving technology advancement and product success with the internal teams and external teams at every stage of technology research, hardware and software design and development. The engineers will need to choose one of the primary technical focuses -- *hardware engineering focus, system engineering focus, or software engineering focus*, while learning from other technical areas in this exciting wireless system development field. The candidates are expected have a high level of professional qualifications in one of three major technical fields.

**Key Responsibilities**:

Participate in technology Research and Development (R&D). technology specification design and development, product software and hardware design and development

Participate in every stage of the technology R&D, including algorithm design, specification development, hardware and software design and development, prototyping, data analysis and other product development tasks

Experience industrial customer-centric methodology in technology and product development; Understand the customers’ requirements, identify the features of the technology and product to meet the customers’ essential needs, design the product according to customers’ expectations

Design specifications, algorithms and structures, evaluate and improve the designs to ensure the the technology meets all requirements; Ensure the quality of the technology and product by teamwork; Follow development procedure and execute the workflow

High level of organizational skills to interact with both internal team members and external collaborators at every stage of algorithm design, hardware design, software design, testing, manufacturing, and customer support, to ensure delivery of the product

Work closely with collaborators to optimize the product in alignment with industrial standards; Work closely with the customer support and marketing team to identify the key issues and make the necessary improvements according to customer feedback

**Qualifications**:

BS/MS/PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or related Engineering and Science fields

Professional qualifications of teamwork, detail-oriented, procedure compliance, strong learning ability, strong ability of adaptation, multitasking and prioritization

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, highly motivated, excellent written and verbal communication abilities; Experience of delivering high-quality technology and products to achieve customer satisfaction

Work experience in one or multiple technical focused fields -- hardware engineering, system engineering, or software engineering. The engineer/intern will choose one focused engineering area, and work with team members in other engineering areas:

*Hardware engineering focus:*

Experience of either digital hardware or analog/RF hardware development; digital hardware experience includes FPGA/ASIC implementation of signal processing algorithms, RTL design verification and UVM testbench development, pipelining and latency optimization, and ASIC physical design

Analog/RF hardware experience includes the development of MIMO antenna arrays, RF upconverter and downconverter designs, power amplifier designs, low-noise amplifier and analog beamformer development

Experience of digital front-end and mixed signal design, including digital sampling rate adjustment, digital up-conversion and down-conversion, digital pre-distortion, digital beamforming and hybrid digital analog beamforming

Experience of wireless PHY hardware development integrating the digital front with PHY digital implementation, the RF subsystem, and the antenna arrays. Experience of FPGA and multi-core CPU integration and optimization.

*System engineering focus:*

Proficient in simulation evaluation of algorithms given 5G system specifications; proficient in simulation platform development to evaluate the critical algorithms together with the hardware engineering team; proficient in machine learning techniques to evaluate algorithms with the software engineering team

Experience in 3GPP specifications with an in-depth understanding of critical physical channels and signaling; experience in developing algorithms across digital PHY receivers and digital and analog front end; experience in 3GPP L2/L3 specifications to evaluate the scheduling algorithms and algorithms in upper layer protocol stacks

Experience in optimizing the algorithms based on the hardware constraints in practical engineering systems; knowledge of hardware timing cycles, algorithm hardware and timing complexities, and methods to reduce the algorithm complexity in hardware

Understanding of wireless receiver design principles and general methods; strong mathematical and theoretical capabilities in algorithm design and evaluation, including probability, signal detection and estimation, matrix theory and optimization

*Software engineering focus:*

Strong knowledge of software protocol stack development in wireless networks; understanding of wireless network architecture, scheduling algorithms, spectrum management techniques, routing algorithms, security and encryption methods

Knowledge and experience of cloud development, GIS development and mobile app development, with hands-on experience of mainstream software development environment in cloud database, GIS platform, web app, and mobile app development

Knowledge and experience of machine learning and deep learning algorithm design and model training in object recognition, image feature extraction, scene reconstruction, robotics navigation, path planning and related technologies

Knowledge and experience of mathematical methods in statistics, algorithms, linear algebra, graphs, and implementation of mathematical models to address practical engineering challenges

Pay: $70,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote
